title: Experts disagree on this request
context:
Chief architect: Ruling: the owner asked for one change, one branch, one PR, and every seat agrees on scope. Ordered small commits in fix order keep each root cause reviewable and revertible inside that one PR. The out-of-scope lines from the other claims stand as non-goals. Accept as recommended.

Target: this request
- solution-architect: out of scope: new HUD visual design beyond docs/instructions/design-system/hud.md, new delivery integrations (CI providers, PR hosts), and showing every unused snapshot field; the change regroups and corrects what exists
- solution-architect: eight root causes across verification, stage-evidence, hud and the plugin mod in one PR is a wide blast radius; land it as small commits in fix order (keep finished change visible, wait for running work, no mint, split verdict, one gate model, done ladder, Trust rebuild) so each is revertible
- product-owner: out of scope: new HUD panels for snapshot data no surface shows today (findings, questions, tech debt, rule overrides), a new visual design beyond docs/instructions/design-system/hud.md, and changing what the stage hooks enforce
- product-owner: eight root causes in one PR is a large change touching the verdict, stage records, checks and HUD at once; the riskiest parts (closing order, stray-change folding) need their own tests so the ladder can be trusted before Trust is rebuilt on top of it
- application-architect: eight root causes across src/verification, src/stage-evidence, src/feature-evidence, src/hud and runtime/claude-plugin/mod in one PR is a large blast radius; land it as ordered commits following the fix order (keep finished change, wait for running work, no mint, split verdict, one gate model, ladder, Trust) so each is reviewable
